data.cultural_impact: The name Shoshanna has a rich cultural history that extends beyond its biblical roots. In various ancient cultures, roses were considered symbols of love, beauty, and passion. Naming a girl Shoshanna would signify the hope for her to embody these qualities and grow into a woman who is beautiful, gracious, and full of love.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Shoshanna holds a deep spiritual significance. It represents God's unending grace and love towards everyone, as seen in the story of Hagar and Ishmael. Shoshanna is a reminder that no matter our background or circumstances, we can all experience God's favor and blessings. Through her name, young girls named Shoshanna can be inspired to embody the grace and love of God in their own lives.

name_in_real_life.story: Elizabeth Shoshanna from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Shoshanna - "Gift of God". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
